alert_rule_overrides_level_check.name: alert_rule_overrides_level_check
alert_rule_overrides_level_check.value: level IS NULL OR level IN ('info','warning','critical')

customer_installers_max_devices.name: customer_installers_max_devices
customer_installers_max_devices.value: max_devices IS NULL OR (max_devices BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)

customer_installers_enrollments.name: customer_installers_enrollments
customer_installers_enrollments.value: enrollments>=0 AND (max_devices IS NULL OR enrollments<=max_devices)

customers_settings_valid.name: customers_settings_valid
customers_settings_valid.value: (audit_retention_days IS NULL OR audit_retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3650) AND ((maintenance_days IS NULL AND maintenance_start IS NULL AND maintenance_duration IS NULL AND maintenance_time_zone IS NULL) OR (maintenance_days IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_start IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_duration IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_time_zone IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_days BETWEEN 1 AND 127 AND maintenance_start BETWEEN 0 AND 1425 AND maintenance_start%15=0 AND maintenance_duration BETWEEN 15 AND 720 AND maintenance_duration%15=0 AND length(maintenance_time_zone) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)) AND revision>=0

desired_assignment_last_result.name: desired_assignment_last_result
desired_assignment_last_result.value: (last_job_id IS NULL AND last_result_state IS NULL AND last_result_at IS NULL) OR (last_job_id IS NOT NULL AND last_result_state IS NOT NULL AND last_result_at IS NOT NULL)

maintenance_runs_result.name: maintenance_runs_result
maintenance_runs_result.value: result IS NULL OR result IS JSON

rdp_rtc_answer_size.name: rdp_rtc_answer_size
rdp_rtc_answer_size.value: answer IS NULL OR length(answer) BETWEEN 24 AND 65536

rdp_session_ack.name: rdp_session_ack
rdp_session_ack.value: input_ack>=0 AND input_ack<=input_seq AND output_ack>=0 AND output_ack<=output_seq

samples_gpus.name: samples_gpus
samples_gpus.value: gpus IS NULL OR (length(gpus)<=65536 AND CASE WHEN gpus IS JSON ARRAY THEN jsonb_array_length(gpus::jsonb)<=16 ELSE false END)
